'''Sheffel Nan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked as a concert promoter in the [[Nessem Shipyards]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She had many friends within the music world and was also acquainted with the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Ssorku]].
